items.description: Triangles, arcs, and circular fragments combine into a dense, irregular mosaic with a hand-cut, tribal-inspired feel. The busy texture works well as a bold accent panel rather than a subtle background screen.

items.title: Ornate Spiraling Fan CNC Panel Lattice Design
items.description: Deliver a captivating, dynamic visual texture with this high-coverage vector template featuring a fluid, spiraling fan and radial scrollwork pattern. Delivered in production-ready DXF, SVG, and DWG file formats, it is tailored for architectural screens that demand high privacy without compromising light or airflow. Mathematically balanced to guarantee flawless execution on CNC routers and waterjet cutters for balcony railings, protective commercial screens, and large-scale decorative facades.
